searchText: Someone should put together an EF grant to improve the bridge bot so it is more useful. Someone should put together another EF grant to convince people that Telegram is terrible and they should use Discord. Hey <@889157410923614209> - I will answer your DM here so others see. ( cc: <@792822129019584562> etc ) I created two Milestones in the Issues log : pq-devnet-0 and pq-devnet-1. Now you can associate Issues on the Project Board with the correct Milestone I set the date for 0 to 9.10.25 and 1 to 10.6.25 <corcoranwill> <gr3999> just want to add a clarification for devnet-0: there WILL be validator voting but without signatures, I will also add some more changes to @unnawut 's PR to add few more things in state for this Hello <@836720546842148864> I have filled the form for PQ interop meetings calendar like 2 times and haven't got any reply for that Can you post the link here? I am not aware of a calendar form <unnawut> re: **@gr3999** > just want to add a clarification for devnet-0: there WILL be validator voting but without signatures, I will also add some more changes to @unnawut 's PR to add few more things in state for this I think only 3 comments left in my PR that I'd love your inputs before I finish it off, so we can start new PRs for specific changes/additions. Can you help check? @gr3999 1. gossip/reqresp protocol ID structure 2. ENR for ed25519. Kolby mentioned it should be supported but I just want to confirm with you also 3. naming block vs lean_block <unnawut> Btw, I got asked whether we're going for md or python specs, so just for clarity, to avoid specs delay I think we should stick to the markdown specs as source of truth for devnet0 (interop without pqsig) I'll try port the entire devnet0 markdown specs to python next week so we can decide md vs python before going into devnet1. <gr3999> re: **@unnawut** > I think only 3 comments left in my PR that I'd love your inputs before I finish it off, so we can start new PRs for specific changes/additions. Can you help check? @gr3999 1. gossip/reqresp protocol ID structure 2. ENR for ed25519. Kolby mentioned it should be supported but I just want to confirm with you also 3. naming block vs lean_block will review by tomorrow and close anything left in DM with you
